{{Top|leg}}
'''Rezzo''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] and his partner, [[Drossh]], entered a disagreement while they were smuggling weapons, and accidentally set them off, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the two of them in the process. Their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Vor'Teth]]'', was later salvaged and sold as scrap.
